title: Blockwise Online-Softmax Attention
prompt:
Implement `blockwise_attention(Q, K, V, block_size)` using NumPy. This is a small, single-head simulation of scaled dot-product attention, `softmax(Q @ K.T / sqrt(d)) @ V`. Inputs are finite 2D arrays: `Q` has shape `(nq, d)`, `K` has shape `(nk, d)`, and `V` has shape `(nk, dv)`; all dimensions are positive. `block_size` is a positive integer and may exceed an input dimension. Return a finite NumPy array of shape `(nq, dv)`.

Process both query rows and key/value columns in tiles no larger than `block_size`. Compute stable attention without materializing a full attention matrix as a separate intermediate; only score tiles of at most `block_size × block_size` may be held at once. Every positive tile size must match stable dense attention within floating-point tolerance. No mask, gradient, or optimized GPU kernel is required. The exact API and tensor shapes are local practice choices; the interview report identifies a FlashAttention implementation task and a basic-simulation interpretation.

example.reasoning: The two attention weights are softmax([1, 0]); their weighted value is about 2.538.
